name: Shokatsuryou Koumei
source:
When she was evacuating a village and met [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url], she was impressed to see the very "Messenger from Heaven" helping the people. She then begs Kazuto to let her join his army, and he allows her to due to his knowledge that she was a master strategist.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
